description:
Buy list and sell list: reversal signals in force across timeframes (technical signals
    screener on your own data). Buy: hammer, 2d-2u, 3-2u, 1-2u in force. Sell: shooter, 2u-2d,
    3-2d, 1-2d in force. Continuations (2u-2u, 2d-2d) do not count. Per timeframe: symbols,
    count, % of basket, trigger, target and level of reclaim; plus which timeframes each
    symbol is on.

as_of.description: Optional ISO time. Use only bars that start at or before this time (replay a past bar).
as_of.title: As Of

basket_by_timeframe.description: Bars per timeframe, then per symbol: {"M": {"AAPL": [...], ...}, "W": {...}}. Up to 4 timeframes; 60 symbols and 500 bars per symbol each.
basket_by_timeframe.title: Basket By Timeframe

now.description: Current time, ISO 8601. Decides if the last bar is still open. Default: the server clock.
now.title: Now

name: buy_sell_list
